verse.text: Discipline your children, and they will give you peace of mind and will make your heart glad.

video.title: Godly Discipline: Every Parent Needs to Know This

reflection: Discipline isn't about anger or control—it's one of the clearest ways a dad shows love, giving a child the boundaries and security they need to thrive. The payoff comes later: a home with less chaos and a heart-deep gladness when you see your kids grow into people of character. It won't feel rewarding in the moment, but staying calm and consistent today is how you build that peace tomorrow.
